tonight.headline: Tuten limped off on the first play, and the week is all but lost
body: Bad news first: Bhayshul Tuten aggravated his foot/ankle on Jacksonville's first snap and limped off; he was later on the sideline bike with no return update (NBC 21:38Z; Heavy 21:36Z). Isaiah Likely was active, as Friday's no-designation report said he would be, but has 0.0 so far. Allen finished with 12.2 after two interceptions, and Warren with 4.9.

ESPN has Panda Attack at 147.5 projected to your 94.6, with a 96% win probability for them. Prescott (35.9), Javonte Williams (24.1) and Pickens (23.8) already scored for them in Dallas' 51-30 win. There is nothing left to change: Jefferson (Sunday 19:20) is your only unlocked starter, and Diggs (Monday) cannot replace a player whose game has started.

case.label: What is left
case.body: Yours: Jefferson tonight with Kirk Cousins at quarterback (Murray out, Rotowire 20 Nov), plus Tuten, Likely and Wilson finishing. Theirs: Skattebo and Little in JAX–NYG, Higgins on Monday.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing you can move. A 50-point swing from four players is the only route, which is why ESPN has you at 4%.
